name: Razor Blades
description: TSA rules for loose razor blades on planes.

carryOn.reason: Loose or detached razor blades are not allowed in carry-on baggage. Only blades fully enclosed in a cartridge razor or electric razor are permitted in carry-on.
exceptions: Razor blades inside a safety razor cartridge are allowed

checkedBag.reason: Loose razor blades are allowed in checked baggage when properly packaged to prevent injury.
conditions: Must be wrapped or packaged securely to prevent injury to baggage handlers

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring razor blades on a plane?

travelTips: Pack spare blades in your checked bag; only cartridge-enclosed blades may travel in carry-on
Wrap loose blades in cardboard or tape before placing in checked baggage

faq.question: Can I bring razor blades in my carry-on?
faq.answer: No. Loose, detached razor blades are not allowed in carry-on bags. They must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can I bring razor blades in checked luggage?
faq.answer: Yes, loose razor blades are allowed in checked baggage when properly wrapped to prevent injury.
